ir.intuition: Shift from traditional margin or sigmoid losses to a differentiable sort-based paradigm, leveraging rank-based softsort of advantage gaps to weight the margin loss. def softsort(x, temperature=0.1):
    # Approximate differentiable sorting to produce soft ranks
    # Here: Use pairwise sigmoid kernel to approximate ranking positions
    n = x.shape[0]
    x_col = ops.stack([x] * n, axis=1)  # shape (n,n)
    x_row = ops.stack([x] * n, axis=0)  # shape (n,n)
    diff = ops.sub(x_row, x_col)  # (n,n)
    sigmoid_matrix = ops.sigmoid(ops.div(diff, temperature))  # smooth indicator if x_row> x_col
    soft_ranks = ops.sum(sigmoid_matrix, axis=1)  # sum over cols: soft rank
    return soft_ranks

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    soft_ranks = softsort(adv_gap, temperature=0.1)
    rank_weights = ops.sub(1.0, soft_ranks)
    hinge_margin = ops.relu(ops.sub(1.0, margin))
    loss = ops.mul(hinge_margin, rank_weights)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
